description:
Author ja for every key once extraction is complete.
- Start with a short glossary so terms stay consistent: 文字起こし (transcript), 話者 (speaker), 話者識別 (speaker identification), 声紋 / 音声プロファイル (voiceprint / voice profile), 要約 (summary), 録音 (recording), ライブ字幕 (live captions), APIキー, マーカー.
- Polite, concise UI register (です/ます for sentences, noun phrases for buttons and menu items).
- Consent and privacy text (cloud audio streaming, Speechmatics voiceprints) must be reviewed by a fluent reader before shipping; don't ship machine translation unreviewed for those.
- Catalog parity check passes; no English left in ja except brand/product names.
title: Japanese catalog: translate and review all strings
